_readme: Labelled frames for the verdict eval. Contract: algorithms — sorting and Big-O
notation (see contract.json). The labels only make sense against that
contract, so if the contract changes topic these must change with it.
'source' is load-bearing — the harness scores the two kinds separately:
synthetic — a rendered mock-up, regenerated by make_synthetic.py. The model
reads its caption text, so these prove the pipeline runs and
prove NOTHING about real screen understanding. Never quotable.
real      — an actual capture from a real machine. Only these count.
'case' is 'hard' when a title/URL blocklist would get it wrong. That subset is
the whole argument for using a multimodal model, so it is reported separately.
